scenario_text:
Catalyst Node Name: chem_C_3_catalyst
Catalyst Name: Catalyst C-3
  Aliases: C-3, 对比催化剂 C-3
  Composition:
    Pd: 1.2 wt%
  Properties:
    pore_volume: 0.23 ml/g
    surface_area: 168 m2/g

Synthesis Pathway:

  Step 1: EUO molecular sieve synthesis (ID: synth_step_1)
    Procedure: The EUO molecular sieve used in the present invention was prepared according to the method of Example 3 of US Patent US6733658.
    Outputs:
      - EUO molecular sieve
        Properties:
          pore_volume: 0.19 mL/g
          silicon_aluminum_molar_ratio: 63 dimensionless
          surface_area: 449 m2/g

  Step 2: Preparation of Hydrogen-form EUO molecular sieve (ID: synth_step_2)
    Procedure: The synthesized zeolite containing alkali metal or alkaline earth metal cations is exchanged with ammonium cations, followed by calcination in air at 316°C to 540°C for 1 to 10 hours.
    Inputs:
      - Ammonium ion source (reagent)
      - EUO molecular sieve (precursor)
        Properties:
          pore_volume: 0.19 mL/g
          silicon_aluminum_molar_ratio: 63 dimensionless
          surface_area: 449 m2/g
    Outputs:
      - Hydrogen-form EUO molecular sieve
    Conditions:
      atmosphere: Air atmosphere
      temperature: 316-540 °C
      time: 1-10 h

  Step 3: Preparation of catalyst support S-1 (ID: synth_step_3)
    Procedure: Mix the acidic EUO molecular sieve obtained in step (1) and alumina powder thoroughly, add 66wt% nitric acid and knead into a plastic paste, extrude into cylindrical strips with a diameter of 1.5mm, dry at 110°C for 8h, and then calcine at 550°C for 6h in an air atmosphere to obtain a support with a diameter of 1.35mm, denoted as S-1. The content of molecular sieve in the support is 60wt%, and the remainder is alumina.
    Inputs:
      - Alumina powder (support precursor)
      - Hydrogen-form EUO molecular sieve (support precursor)
      - Nitric acid (peptizer)
      - Water (solvent)
    Outputs:
      - Catalyst support S-1
        Composition:
          Alumina: 40 wt%
          EUO molecular sieve: 60 wt%
        Properties:
          diameter: 1.35 mm
    Conditions:
      calcination_atmosphere: Air atmosphere
      calcination_temperature: 550 °C
      calcination_time: 6 h
      drying_temperature: 110 °C
      drying_time: 8 h

  Step 4: Preparation of Catalyst C-3 (ID: synth_step_6)
    Procedure: Preparation of the support is the same as in Comparative Example 1. Take 200 grams of the above support S-1, perform ion exchange using a solution containing PdCl2 at 45°C for 48 hours, then dry at 80°C for 24h, and calcine at 550°C for 2h in an air atmosphere to obtain the comparative catalyst C-3 containing 1.2wt% Pd.
    Inputs:
      - Catalyst support S-1 (support)
        Composition:
          Alumina: 40 wt%
          EUO molecular sieve: 60 wt%
        Properties:
          diameter: 1.35 mm
      - PdCl2 (precursor)
      - Water (solvent)
    Outputs:
      - Catalyst C-3
        Composition:
          Pd: 1.2 wt%
        Properties:
          pore_volume: 0.23 ml/g
          surface_area: 168 m2/g
    Conditions:
      calcination_atmosphere: Air atmosphere
      calcination_temperature: 550 °C
      calcination_time: 2 h
      drying_temperature: 80 °C
      drying_time: 24 h
      exchange_temperature: 45 °C
      exchange_time: 48 h

Testing Scenarios:

  Scenario 1: Xylene isomerization over C-3 catalyst at 380 °C (ID: test_3)
    Conditions:
      catalyst_volume: 100 ml
      diluent: 100ml Quartz sand material
      feed_composition_ethylbenzene: 7.9 vol%
      feed_composition_m_xylene: 70.2 vol%
      feed_composition_o_xylene: 21.8 vol%
      feed_composition_p_xylene: 0.1 vol%
      hydrogen_hydrocarbon_molar_ratio: 2:1 ratio
      pretreatment_atmosphere: H2 gas
      pretreatment_duration: 4 h
      pretreatment_temperature: 653 K
      reaction_pressure: 1.0 MPa
      reaction_temperature: 380 ℃
      weight_hourly_space_velocity: 20 h⁻¹
    Results:
      ethylbenzene_conversion_rate: 40.6 %
      p_xylene_concentration_in_total_xylenes: 23.8 %
      xylene_loss: 4.1 %
